description: Installation of a dropped kerb and crossover, to facilitate car parking space to front yard, new bin store, landscape and boundary amendments
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed dropped kerb, by reason of its scale, design and location, would result in an incongruous, incompatible and obtrusive form of development that would result in a detrimental impact on the character and appearance of the streetscene.</span><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;"> And would undermine sustainable transport objectives. As such the proposal would be contrary to</span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;"> </span><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) policies LP43 ( Transport and Development , LP45 (Parking and Car Free Development),&nbsp; of the Hackney Local Plan LP33,&nbsp; Policies D3 (</span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach)&nbsp; D4 (Delivering good design) </span><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">T6 (Car Parking) of the London Plan (2021). Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD 2025 and </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Transport Strategy 2015-2025. </span></p><div><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;"><br></span></div>

<p>The provision and facilitation of off-street parking spaces at a site with PTAL 5 rating through a dropped kerb fails to promote sustainable modes of transport and does not promote car free residential development, contrary to London Plan (2021) Policy T6.1 (Residential parking) and Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) Policies&nbsp;LP43 (Transport and Development) and LP45 (Parking and Car Free Development).&nbsp;</p>
